purpose: Columns that prisma/schema.postgres.prisma declares and no file under supabase/migrations/ creates, recorded as accepted debt on 2026-09-06 with 33 entries when preflight schema-migration-drift was introduced. This list may only shrink: preflight raises a CRITICAL for any declared column not created by a migration and not listed here. Never add an entry to silence a new column — write the migration instead. The entries fall in three groups, and each needs a different repayment: (1) PersonCredential and PasswordResetToken were declared in the schema on 2026-08-19 (9a149d6) BECAUSE they already existed on production, created outside this migration tree, so their repayment is a migration that records them with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; (2) PlanImportReceipt and the eight Workstream execution-contract columns entered the schema on 2026-08-19 (be14e20, PR #67) with a prisma/migrations/ file only, one day after the Supabase application schema was dumped, and whether production has them is unverified — the same shape of gap as RawExternalRecord.artifactId; their repayment is an idempotent Supabase migration plus an operator apply; (3) nothing else. RawExternalRecord.artifactId is deliberately NOT here: its migration ships with this baseline, and the unit test reintroduces its absence to prove the check fires. See .brain/rca/2026-09-06-a-schema-column-with-no-migration.md
